verdict.rationale: Vestd is a SaaS equity-management platform, so offering official SDKs is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no mention of any SDK or public developer API, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. The HRIS integration is a product feature, not a developer SDK, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
